BiblicalUsage: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, is named among David's mighty men. He is listed once, in the roll of the thirty, with no deed attached to his name.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the roll of the mighty men is a roll of the faithful, and Heleb's name among them is his honour.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
